FROM risk_classification
WHERE grade_code = '次级'
ORDER BY loan_id ASC;

SELECT payment_id, business_date, amount
FROM payment_event
WHERE is_cash = 1 AND amount > 5000000
ORDER BY amount DESC;

SELECT p.party_id, pp.annual_income
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND pp.annual_income > 1000000
ORDER BY pp.annual_income DESC;

SELECT card_id, issued_on, expires_on
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = '贷记卡'
ORDER BY issued_on ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    op.operating_status
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou_ref ON op.registered_region = ou_ref.region_code
JOIN 
    institution i ON ou_ref.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou_target ON i.institution_id = (
        SELECT institution_id 
        FROM organization_unit 
        WHERE unit_name = '上海分行' 
        LIMIT 1
    ) AND ou_target.region_code = ou_ref.region_code
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'ORGANIZATION'
ORDER BY 
    p.party_id ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM 
    organization_unit ou
LEFT JOIN 
    account a ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    account_count DESC;

SELECT 
    s.sector_name_zh,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector s ON op.industry_code = s.sector_code
GROUP BY 
    s.sector_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    SUM(phs.carrying_amount) AS total_market_value
FROM 
    wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
GROUP BY 
    wp.product_id, wp.product_name
ORDER BY 
    total_market_value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(pr.relation_id) AS relation_count
FROM 
    party_relation pr
JOIN 
    party p ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit!_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    relation_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cs.net_capital,
    cs.risk_weighted_assets
FROM 
    capital_snapshot cs
JOIN 
    institution i ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
ORDER BY 
    cs.net_capital DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(abs.balance.ledger_balance) AS total_deposit_balance
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    account a ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN 
    account_holder ah ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN 
    account_balance_snapshot abs ON a.account_id = abs.account_id
WHERE 
    a.account_kind LIKE '%储蓄%'
    AND ah.holder_role = '所有者'
    AND abs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM account_balance_snapshot abs2 
        WHERE abs2.account_id = a.account_id
    )
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_deposit_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days) AS avg_overdue_days
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days) > 90
ORDER BY 
    avg_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id AS group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    SUM(re.gross_exposure) AS total_exposure,
    (SUM(re.gross_exposure) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital) AS exposure_to_capital_ratio
FROM 
    exposure_group eg
JOIN 
    risk_exposure re ON eg.exposure_group_id = re.exposure_group_id
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON eg.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE 
    re.as_of_date = cs.as_of_date
    AND re.currency_code = cs.currency_code
GROUP BY 
    eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
ORDER BY 
    exposure_to!_to_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    s.sector_name_en AS sector_name,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loan_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rc.grade_code IN ('Substandard', 'Doubtful', 'Loss') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS npl_loan_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rc.grade_code IN ('Substandard', 'Doubtful', 'Loss') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(l.loan_id) AS npl_ratio
FROM 
    loan_drawdown l
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector s ON op.industry_code = s.sector_code
LEFT JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON l.loan_id = rc.loan_id AND rc.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM risk_classification WHERE loan_id = l.loan_id
    )
GROUP BY 
    s.sector_code, s.sector_name_en
HAVING 
    COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 20
ORDER BY 
    npl_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT 
    risk_level,
    COUNT(*) AS product_count,
    AVG(management_fee_rate) AS avg_management_fee_rate
FROM 
    wealth_product
GROUP BY 
    risk_level
ORDER BY 
    risk_level ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS guarantor_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed_balance
FROM 
    guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN 
    party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE 
    gc.status = '有效'
    AND (gc.effective_to IS NULL OR gc.effective_to >= datetime('now'))
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > 50000!00000
ORDER BY 
    total_guaranteed_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN 
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
JOIN 
    credit_participant cp ON p.party_id = cp.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON cp.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE 
    pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
    AND rtc.relation_name_zh LIKE '%关联方%'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY 
   !total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(dse.record_id) AS record_count,
    SUM(dse.observed_value) AS total_observed_value
FROM 
    data_security_event_v3 dse
JOIN 
    institution i ON dse.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    dse.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_observed_value DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_count
FROM 
    regulatory_submission_event_v3 r
JOIN 
    institution i ON r.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    r.deadline_date IS NOT NULL
    AND (r.completion_date IS NULL OR r.completion_date > r.deadline_date)
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.in!institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY 
    overdue_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cs.net_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets AS capital_adequacy_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE 
    cs.risk_weighted_assets IS NOT NULL 
    AND cs.risk_weighted_assets != 0
ORDER BY 
    capital_adequacy_ratio ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ds.principal_overdue_days,
    cg.grade_name_zh AS classification_name,
    rc.as_of_date AS classification_date
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan!id = rc.loan_id
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE 
    ds.principal_overdue_days > 90
    AND rc.grade_code IN ('NORMAL', 'SPECIAL_MENTION')
    AND rc.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(rc_inner.as_of_date)
        FROM risk_classification rc_inner
        WHERE rc_inner.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
ORDER BY 
    ds.principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(ls.principal_balance - COALESCE(p.required_amount, 0)) AS insufficient_provision_balance
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot ls ON ld.loan_id = ls.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN 
    provision_snapshot p ON ld.loan_id = p.loan_id AND ls.as_of_date = p.as_of_date
WHERE 
    ls.principal_balance > COALESCE(p.required_amount, 0)
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    SUM(ls.principal_balance - COALES![](p.required_amount, 0)) > 100000000
ORDER BY 
    insufficient_provision_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    p.display_name AS payee_name,
    isec.sector_name_zh,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM 
    payment_instruction pi
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector isec ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE 
    pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
    AND isec.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
ORDER BY 
    pi.instruction_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ind.risk_category IN ('限制类', '退出类') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END) AS违规流入金额，
    SUM(pi.instruction_amount) AS 指令金额合计，
    SUM(CASE WHEN ind.risk_category IN ('限制类', '退出类') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(pi.instruction![](image.png) AS 占比
FROM 
    payment_instruction pi
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party borrower ON ca.borrower_party_id = borrower.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON borrower.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector ind ON op.industry_code = ind.sector_code
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    占比 DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_id,
    ma.maturity_on AS asset_maturity_date,
    wp.actual_termination_on AS product_termination_date
FROM 
    wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN 
    managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE 
    ma.maturity_on > wp.actual_termination_on
ORDER BY 
    ma.maturity_on DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantee_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS borrower_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    guarantor_commitment gc ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    guarantee_count DESC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    ptc.name_zh AS payment_type_name_zh,
    pe.amount,
    ou.unit_name AS org_unit_name
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON pe.origin_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE 
    pe.is_cash = 1
    AND pe.amount > 5000000.0
    AND pe.status = 'CLEARED'
ORDER BY 
    pe.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ind_sec_reg.sector_name_zh AS borrower_industry_name,
    ind_sec_target.sector_name_zh AS target_industry_name,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector ind_sec_reg ON op.industry_code = ind_sec_reg.sector_code
JOIN 
    industry_sector ind_sec_target ON ca.target_industry_code = ind_sec_target.sector_code
WHERE 
    ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL 
    AND op.industry_code IS NOT NULL 
    AND ca.target_industry_code != op.industry_code
ORDER BY 
    ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    ah_from.party_id AS payer_party_id,
    ah_to.party_id AS payee_party_id
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    account_holder ah_from ON pe.from_account_id = ah_from.account_id AND ah_from.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN 
    account_holder ah_to ON pe.to_account_id = ah_to.account_id AND ah!_to.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN 
    party_relation pr ON ah_from.party_id = pr.source_party_id AND ah_to.party_id = pr.target_party_id
WHERE 
    pe.status = 'CLEARED'
    AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_AFFILIATE'
ORDER BY 
    pe.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY 
    ca.agreement_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 3
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    SUM(pe.amount) AS total_amount
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    account a ON (pe.from_account_id = a.account_id OR pe.to_account_id = a.account_id)
JOIN 
    institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    pe.is_cash = 1 
    AND pe.amount > 5000000
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY 
    total_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    sm.staff_id,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    service_operator so ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
JOIN 
    staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN 
    account to_acc ON pe.to_account_id = to_acc.account_id
JOIN 
    account_holder ah ON to_acc.account_id = ah.account_id 
    AND ah.effective_to IS NULL
JOIN 
    party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector isec ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE 
    isec.sector_name_en IN ('Restricted', 'Exit')
    OR isec.sector_name_zh LIKE '%限制%'
    OR isec.sector_name_zh LIKE '%退出%'
GROUP BY 
    sm.staff_id
ORDER BY 
    transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 1!0;

SELECT 
    t.record_id,
    i.institution_name,
    t.event_date,
    t.deadline_date,
    CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(t.deadline_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_overdue
FROM 
    customer_due_diligence_event_v3 t
JOIN 
    institution i ON t.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    t.event_date <= '2026-06-!-30'
    AND t.completion_date IS NULL
ORDER BY 
    days_overdue DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.status AS collateral_status,
    sa.status AS security_status
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN 
    collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'RELEASED'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    sa.security_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ca.agreement_id,
    sa.security_id,
    so.covered_amount
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN 
    security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE 
    ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND (sa.effective_to IS NULL OR sa.effective_to > DATE('now'))
ORDER BY 
    so.covered_amount DESC;

WITH loan_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.disbursed_amount AS principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY i.institution_id 
            ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM institution i
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE ld.status != 'CLOSED'
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_name,
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY institution_id 
            ORDER BY principal_balance DESC
        ) AS balance_rank
    FROM loan_balances
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    balance_rank
FROM ranked_loans
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

WITH loan_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.loan_id,
        ca.contract_amount AS principal_balance,
        op.industry_code
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        lb.loan_id,
        lb.principal_balance,
        lb.industry_code,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY lb.industry_code 
            ORDER BY lb.principal_balance DESC
        ) as industry_rank
    FROM loan_balances lb
)
SELECT 
    is.sector_name_zh AS industry_name_zh,
    rl.loan_id,
    rl.principal_balance,
    rl.industry_rank
FROM ranked_loans rl
JOIN industry_sector is ON rl.industry_code = is.sector_code
WHERE rl.industry_rank <= 3
ORDER BY is.sector_name_zh ASC, rl.industry_rank ASC;

SELECT 
    business_date,
    transaction_count,
    transaction_count - LAG(transaction_count, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS count_change
FROM (
    SELECT 
        business_date,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM payment_event
    GROUP BY business_date
)
ORDER BY business_date ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    td.opening_principal AS principal_balance,
    avg_stats.avg_principal AS avg_principal_balance,
    (td.opening_principal - avg_stats.avg_principal) AS excess_amount
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    term_deposit td ON ld.loan_account_id = td.account_id
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            i_sub.institution_id,
            AVG(td_sub.opening_principal) AS avg_principal
        FROM 
            loan_drawdown ld_sub
        JOIN 
            credit_agreement ca_sub ON ld_sub.agreement_id = ca_sub.agreement_id
        JOIN 
            institution i_sub ON ca_sub.institution_id = i_sub![]()
        JOIN 
            term_deposit td_sub ON ld_sub.loan_account_id = td_sub.account_id
        GROUP BY 
            i_sub.institution_id
    ) avg_stats ON i.institution_id = avg_stats.institution_id
WHERE 
    td.opening_principal > avg_stats.avg_principal
ORDER BY 
    excess_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
LEFT JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
WHERE 
    sa.security_type = 'Third Party Guarantee'
    AND cl.collateral_link_id IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 
    sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN julianday('now') - julianday(current_maturity_on) <= 0 THEN 0
        WHEN julianday('now') - julianday(current_maturity_on) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 1
        WHEN julianday('now') - julianday(current_maturity_on) BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN 31
        WHEN julianday('now') - julianday(current_maturity_on) BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 91
        WHEN julianday('now') - julianday(current_maturity_on) BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN 181
        ELSE 361
    END AS overdue_interval_start,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown
WHERE status != 'CLOSED' OR (status = 'CLOSED' AND closed_on IS NULL)
GROUP BY overdue_interval_start
ORDER BY overdue_interval_start ASC;

SELECT 
    collateral_id,
    valuation_date,
    COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count
FROM collateral_valuation
GROUP BY collateral_id, valuation_date
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY collateral_id ASC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_principal,
    AVG(ld.disbursed_amount) AS avg_loan_amount
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'ORGANIZATION'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    avg_loan_amount DESC
LIMIT !5;

SELECT 
    ou.unit_name AS org_unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS cash_transaction_count
FROM 
    organization_unit ou
JOIN 
    staff_member sm ON ou.org_unit_id = sm.home_org_unit_id
JOIN 
    payment_event pe ON sm.staff_id = pe.operator_id
WHERE 
    pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    cash_transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
    AVG(pp.annual_income) AS avg_annual_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pp.annual_income > 1000000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS high_income_ratio
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'PERSON'
GROUP BY 
    p.customer_segment
ORDER BY 
    p.customer_segment ASC;

WITH account_holders AS (
    SELECT 
        ah.account_id,
        ah.party_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ah.account_id ORDER BY ah.effective_from DESC) as rn
    FROM account_holder ah
),
primary_holders AS (
    SELECT account_id, party_id
    FROM account_holders
    WHERE rn = 1
),
related_parties AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.source_party_id,
        pr.target_party_id
    FROM party_relation pr
    WHERE pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
),
transaction_with_parties AS (
    SELECT 
        pe.payment_id,
        pe.origin_org_unit_id,
        acc_from.institution_id as from_inst_id,
        acc_to.institution_id as to_inst_id,
        ph_from.party_id as from_party,
        ph_to.party_id as to_party,
        pe.amount
    FROM payment_event pe
    JOIN account acc_from ON pe.from_account_id = acc_from.account_id
    JOIN account acc_to ON pe.to_account_id = acc_to.account_id
    LEFT JOIN primary_holders ph_from ON pe.from_account_id = ph_from.account_id
    LEFT JOIN primary_holders ph_to ON pe.to_account_id = ph_to.account_id
),
transactions_with_relation AS (
    SELECT 
        twp.payment_id,
        COALESCE(twp.from_inst_id, twp.to_inst_id) as inst_id,
        twp.amount,
        CASE 
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM related_parties rp 
                WHERE rp.source_party_id = twp.from_party 
                AND rp.target_party_id = twp.to_party
            ) THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END as is_related
    FROM transaction_with_parties twp
    WHERE twp.from_party IS NOT NULL AND twp.to_party IS NOT NULL
),
agg_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN twr.is_related = 1 THEN twr.amount ELSE 0 END) as related_amount,
        SUM(twr.amount) as total_amount
    FROM transactions_with_relation twr
    JOIN institution i ON twr.inst_id = i.institution_id
    GROUP BY i.institution_name
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    related_amount,
    total_amount,
    (related_amount * 1.0 / total_amount) as ratio
FROM agg_stats
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS credit_card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) AS term_deposit_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN 
    account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    payment_card pc ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id AND pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
LEFT JOIN 
    term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type =! 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) > 0 
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) > 0
ORDER BY 
    term_deposit_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    AVG(JULIANDAY('2026-06-30') - JULIANDAY(l.disbursed_on)) AS avg_loan_age_days
FROM 
    loan_drawdown l
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    l.disbursed_on IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution!name
ORDER BY 
    avg_loan_age_days DESC;

WITH quartiles AS (
    SELECT 
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) AS quartile_group
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
)
SELECT 
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    quartile_group
FROM quartiles
ORDER BY quartile_group ASC, principal_balance DESC, loan_id ASC
LIMIT 40;

WITH industry_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.target_industry_code,
        SUM(ld.principal_balance) AS total_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.target_industry_code
),
industry_with_name AS (
    SELECT 
        ilb.target_industry_code,
        isec.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
        ilb.total_balance
    FROM industry_loan_balance ilb
    JOIN industry_sector isec ON ilb.target_industry_code = isec.sector_code
),
total_balance_calc AS (
    SELECT SUM(total_balance) AS grand_total FROM industry_with_name
),
ranked_industries AS (
    SELECT 
        iwn.industry_name,
        iwn.total_balance,
        SUM(iwn.total_balance) OVER (ORDER BY iwn.total_balance DESC) AS cumulative_balance,
        tbc.grand_total
    FROM industry_with_name iwn
    CROSS JOIN total_balance_calc tbc
),
cumulative_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        industry_name,
        total_balance,
        (cumulative_balance * 1.0 / grand_total) AS cumulative_ratio
    FROM ranked_industries
)
SELECT 
    industry_name,
    total_balance,
    cumulative_ratio
FROM cumulative_stats
WHERE cumulative_ratio <= 0.8
ORDER BY cumulative_ratio ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS outstanding_loan_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    ld.status != 'CLOSED'
    AND ld.closed_on IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    outstanding_loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    ca.collateral_id,
    cv.valuation_amount
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN 
    collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN 
    collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
WHERE 
    cv.valuation_amount > (sa.secured_amount * 2.0)
    AND cv.valid_until IS NULL
ORDER BY 
    (cv.valuation_amount - sa.secured_amount) DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) AS institution_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN 
    account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'PERSON'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) > 2
ORDER BY 
    institution_count DESC;

SELECT 
    from_account_id AS account_id,
    business_date AS transaction_date,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM 
    payment_event
WHERE 
    from_account_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    from_account_id, business_date
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY 
    transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    SUM(COALESCE(ld.disbursed_amount, 0)) AS total_loan_balance
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    exposure_group eg ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN 
    exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
LEFT JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id AND ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id AND ld.status != 'CLOSED'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_loan_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS guarantor_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantee_contract_count,
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM 
    guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN 
    party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) > 1
    AND SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY 
    total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
    AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON ld.managing_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ou.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND lbs.overdue_since IS NOT NULL
    AND julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(lbs.overdue_since) >= 90
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    pi.instruction_amount,
    payee_p.display_name AS payee_name
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    payment_instruction pi ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN 
    party payee_p ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = payee_p.party_id
WHERE 
    ld.payment_mode = '受托支付'
    AND ca.borrower_party_id = pi.intended_payee_party_id
ORDER BY 
    pi.instruction_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.target_party_id
WHERE 
    pr.relation_type = 'CUSTOMER_OF_INSTITUTION'
    AND pr.source_party_id IN (
        SELECT party_id FROM party WHERE party_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND status = 'FROZEN'
    )
    AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.industry_code,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    wealth_product wp ON ca.product_family = wp.product_id -- 假设 product_family 关联产品 ID，若逻辑不同需调整
JOIN 
    managed_asset ma ON wp.product_id = ma.asset_id -- 假设投向行业在底层资产中定义
WHERE 
    wp.product_category = '流动资金类'
    AND ma.asset_category_primary = '退出类'
    AND ld.status = '正常'
ORDER BY 
    ld.disbursed_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS principal_balance,
    inst_avg.avg_balance AS institution_avg_balance,
    (ld.disbursed_amount - inst_avg.avg_balance) AS excess_difference
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            ca_inner.institution_id,
            AVG(ld_inner.disbursed_amount) AS avg_balance
        FROM 
            loan_drawdown ld_inner
        JOIN 
            credit_agreement ca_inner ON ld_inner.agreement_id = ca_inner.agreement_id
        GROUP BY 
            ca_inner.institution_id
    ) inst_avg ON ca.institution_id = inst_avg.institution_id
WHERE 
    ld.disbursed_amount > 2.0 * inst_avg.avg_balance
ORDER BY 
    excess_difference DESC;

WITH all_exposures AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM institution i
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
),
non_related_exposures AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS non_related_amount
    FROM institution i
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM party_relation pr
        WHERE pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
          AND pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
    )
    GROUP BY i.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    ae.institution_name,
    COALESCE(nre.non_related_amount, 0.0) AS non_related_amount,
    ae.total_amount,
    (COALESCE(nre.non_related_amount, 0.0) * 1.0 / ae.total_amount) AS ratio
FROM all_exposures ae
LEFT JOIN non_related_exposures nre ON ae.institution_id = nre.institution_id
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    SUM(ca.carrying_amount) AS total_balance,
    cs.net_capital,
    (SUM(ca.carrying_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital) AS concentration_ratio
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND cs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot WHERE institution_id = i.institution_id)
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, p.party_id, i.institution_name, p.display_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING 
    (SUM(ca.carrying_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital) > 0.10
ORDER BY 
    concentration_ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

WITH industry_avg_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.target_industry_code,
        AVG(ca.annual_interest_rate) AS avg_industry_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL 
      AND ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca.target_industry_code
)
SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ca.annual_interest_rate AS execution_rate,
    iar.avg_industry_rate AS industry_avg_rate,
    ROUND((ca.annual_interest_rate - iar.avg_industry_rate) * 100.0 / iar.avg_industry_rate, 2) AS markup_percentage
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN industry_avg_rates iar ON ca.target_industry_code = iar.target_industry_code
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND iar.avg_industry_rate > 0
  AND (ca.!annual_interest_rate - iar.avg_industry_rate) * 100.0 / iar.avg_industry_rate > 10.0
ORDER BY markup_percentage DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.borrower_party_id) AS exceeded_customer_count
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE 
    ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND cs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM capital_snapshot 
        WHERE institution_id = i.institution_id
    )
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING 
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital > 0.10
ORDER BY 
    exceeded_customer_count DESC;

WITH group_exposures AS (
    SELECT 
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        eg.group_name,
        eg.institution_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(ld.disbursed_amount - COALESCE(lbs.principal_balance, 0), 0)) AS total_balance
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON egm.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id 
        AND lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id)
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, eg.institution_id
),
capital_limits AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot cs2 WHERE cs2.institution_id = capital_snapshot.institution_id)
)
SELECT 
    ge.exposure_group_id AS group_id,
    ge.group_name,
    ge.total_balance AS balance_sum,
    cl.net_capital AS net_capital,
    (ge.total_balance * 1.0 / cl.net_capital) AS concentration_ratio
FROM group_exposures ge
JOIN capital_limits cl ON ge.institution_id = cl.institution_id
WHERE (ge.total_balance * 1.0 / cl.net_capital) > 0.10
ORDER BY concentration_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.maturity_on,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.status,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'expired'
    AND ld.status = 'normal'
ORDER BY 
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) AS days_between
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    payment_event pe ON ld.disbursement_account_id = pe.from_account_id
WHERE 
    pe.status = 'SETTLED'
    AND pe.business_date >= ld.disbursed_on
    AND CAST(julianday(pe.business!_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) <= 7
ORDER BY 
    days_between ASC,
    pe.amount DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

WITH LoanBalances AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        ca.obligor_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance
    FROM institution i
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    WHERE p.party_type = 'ORGANIZATION'
      AND lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 WHERE lbs2.loan_id = lbs.loan_id)
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, ca.obligor_party_id
),
CapitalSnapshots AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        MAX(net_capital) AS max_net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
Ratios AS (
    SELECT 
        lb.institution_id,
        lb.institution_name,
        lb.obligor_party_id,
        p.display_name AS customer_name,
        (lb.total_principal_balance * 1.0 / cs.max_net_capital) AS ratio
    FROM LoanBalances lb
    JOIN CapitalSnapshots cs ON lb.institution_id = cs.institution_id
    JOIN party p ON lb.obligor_party_id =! p.party_id
),
RankedRatios AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_name,
        customer_name,
        ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY institution_id ORDER BY ratio DESC) AS rn
    FROM Ratios
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    customer_name,
    ratio
FROM RankedRatios
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    ntile_val AS quartile
FROM (
    SELECT 
        lbs.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY i.institution_id ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC) AS ntile_val
    FROM 
        loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN 
        loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN 
        credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN 
        institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    WHERE 
        lbs.as_of_date = (
            SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
            FROM loan_balance_snapshot 
            WHERE loan_id = lbs.loan_id
        )
) sub
ORDER BY 
    quartile ASC,
    principal_balance DESC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 * 100.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id), 2) AS percentage
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
ORDER BY 
    i.institution_name ASC,
    percentage DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount,
    ld.status,
    SUM(CASE WHEN are.event_type = 'OVERDUE_PRINCIPAL' THEN are.amount ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_principal_total,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN are.event_type = 'OVERDUE_PERIOD' THEN 1 END) AS overdue_period_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    asset_resolution_event are ON ld.loan_id = are.loan_id
WHERE 
    ld.status = 'NORMAL'
GROUP BY 
    ld.loan_id, ld.disb![](https://i.imgur.com/8QkZvzr.png)ursed_amount, ld.status
HAVING 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN are.event_type = 'OVERDUE_PERIOD' THEN 1 END) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    overdue_period_count DESC, 
    overdue_principal_total DESC, 
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    loan_account_id,
    disbursed_on,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown
GROUP BY 
    loan_account_id,
    disbursed_on
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT DISTINCT ah.party_id
FROM account_holder ah
JOIN account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ah.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY ah.party_id ASC;

SELECT sm.person_party_id

    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
),
RankedLoans AS (
    SELECT 
        l.repayment_account_id,
        l.loan_id,
        l.disbursed_on,
        l.disbursed_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.repayment_account_id ORDER BY l.disbursed_on ASC) AS rn

SELECT

    payee_party.display_name AS payee_name,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count,
    SUM(pe.amount) AS total_amount

    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    account from_acc ON pe.from_account_id = from_acc.account_id
JOIN 
    account_holder ah_from ON from_acc.account_id = ah_from.account_id
JOIN 
    party payer_party ON ah_from.party_id = payer_party.party_id
JOIN 
    account to_acc ON pe.to_account_id = to_acc.account_id

    account_holder ah_to ON to_acc.account_id = ah_to.account_id

    party payee_party ON ah_to.party_id = payee_party.party_id

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ABS(ABS(bs.ledger_balance) - ABS(COALESCE(late.latest_overdue_amount, 0))) AS book_principal_balance,
    late.max_overdue_days
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    account_balance_snapshot bs ON ld.loan_account_id = bs.account_id
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            loan_id,
            MAX(julianday('now') - julianday(as_of_date)) AS max_overdue_days,
            SUM(CASE WHEN debit_balance > 0 THEN debit_balance ELSE 0 END) AS latest_overdue_amount
        FROM 
            account_balance_snapshot abs
        JOIN 
            loan_drawdown ld_inner ON abs.account_id = ld_inner.loan_account_id
        WHERE 
            abs.debit_balance > 0
        GROUP BY 
            loan_id
    ) late ON ld.loan!id = late.loan_id
WHERE 
    ABS(ABS(bs.ledger_balance) - ABS(COALESCE(late.latest_overdue_amount, 0))) > 90000000
    AND late.latest_overdue_amount > 0
    AND late.max_overdue_days >= 200
ORDER BY 
    late.max_overdue_days DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

    SUM(CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(ld.current_maturity_on)) / 30 AS INTEGER)) AS overdue_periods,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_overdue_principal

    loan_drawdown ld

    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id

    loan_product_catalog lpc ON ca.product_family = lpc.product_family

    ld.status != 'CLOSED'
    AND julianday('now') > julianday!@ld.current_maturity_on@

    term_deposit td

    account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id

    institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20
ORDER BY 
    expired_count DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT

FROM 
    institution i

    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id

    provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id

    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id AND ps.as_of_date = rc.as_of_date

    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code

          SELECT issuer_institution_id FROM wealth_product WHERE product_id = (SELECT product_id FROM DeepHoldings LIMIT 1)
      )
    -- 注意：上述子查询逻辑在 CTE 中无法动态获取 product_id，需调整策略
),
IssuerOverdueSum AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lds.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lds ON ld.loan_id = lds.loan_id
    JOIN wealth_product wp ON ca.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id -- 关联发行机构
    JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
    WHERE lds.overdue_principal > 0
      AND phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT 
    dh.product_name,
    dh.underlying_asset_name,
    dh.lookthrough_depth,
    dh.carrying_amount,
    ios.total_overdue_principal
FROM DeepHoldings dh
JOIN IssuerOverdueSum ios ON dh.issuer_party_id = ios.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY dh.lookthrough_depth DESC, dh.asset_id ASC;

SELECT 
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS first_priority_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_pledge_count
FROM 
    collateral_link cl
JOIN 
    collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE 
    cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND cl.lien_priority = 1
GROUP BY 
    cl.collateral_id
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    high_p!_pledge_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    fs.total_assets,
    fs.total_liabilities,
    fs.net_assets,
    fs.annual_revenue
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY 
    fs.!annual_revenue DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(CAST(fs.total_liabilities AS REAL) / fs.total_assets, 4) AS debt_asset_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE 
    fs.total_assets > 0
ORDER BY 
    debt_asset_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.tier1_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS core_tier1_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE 
    cs.risk_weighted_assets IS NOT NULL 
    AND cs.risk_weighted_assets != 0
ORDER BY 
    core_tier1_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 6) AS capital_to_asset_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON 'PTY-' || i.institution_id = fs.party_id
WHERE 
    fs.total_assets > 0
ORDER BY 
    capital_to_asset_ratio DESC;

WITH institution_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        fs.annual_revenue
    FROM institution i
    JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = ('PTY-' || i.institution_id)
    WHERE fs.annual_revenue IS NOT NULL
),
total_revenue AS (
    SELECT SUM(annual_revenue) AS total_sum
    FROM institution_revenue
),
revenue_with_ratio AS (
    SELECT 
        ir.institution_id,
        ir.institution_name,
        ir.annual_revenue,
        (ir.annual_revenue * 1.0 / tr.total_sum) AS ratio
    FROM institution_revenue ir
    CROSS JOIN total_revenue tr
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    annual_revenue,
    ROUND(ratio * 100, 2) AS ratio_percent
FROM revenue_with_ratio
WHERE ratio > 0.15
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    COUNT(*) AS mismatch_count
FROM 
    managed_asset ma
JOIN 
    institution i ON ma.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    ma.internal_rating IS NOT NULL 
    AND ma.external_rating IS NOT NULL 
    AND ma.internal_rating != ma.external_rating
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id
ORDER BY 
    mismatch_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ma.valuation_method,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM 
    product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN 
    managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
GROUP BY 
    ma.valuation_method
ORDER BY 
    total_carrying_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS account_count,
    ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS total_principal
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    account a ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN 
    term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE 
    a.account_kind = 'term_deposit'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution!name
ORDER BY 
    total_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS deposit_count
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    account a ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN 
    term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE 
    td.annual_interest_rate > 0.03
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    deposit_count DESC;

SELECT 
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.operator_id) AS operator_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM 
    service_operator so
JOIN 
    staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE 
    sm.employment_type = 'Fixed'
GROUP BY 
    so.authority_level
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY 
    operator_count DESC,
    so.authority_level ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS deposit_count
FROM 
    term_deposit td
JOIN 
    account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30'
    AND td.maturity_on <= date('2026-!@#$%^&*()_+06-30', '+30 days')
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    deposit_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount) AS under_provision_total,
    fs.net_assets,
    ROUND((SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount) * 1.0 / fs.net_assets) * 100, 2) AS under_provision_ratio_pct
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
        SELECT ca.agreement_id 
        FROM credit_agreement ca 
        WHERE ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    )
JOIN 
    provision_snapshot ps ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE 
    ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name, fs.net_assets
HAVING 
    SUM(ps.required!_amount - ps.recognized_amount) > 0
ORDER BY 
    under_provision_ratio_pct DESC, i.institution_id ASC;

SELECT 
    rc.grade_code AS risk_classification_name,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
WHERE 
    rc.classification_basis = '人工认定'
    AND rc.grade_code IN ('次级', '可疑', '损失')
GROUP BY 
    rc.grade_code
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC, 
    risk_classification_name ASC;

WITH npl_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS npl_count,
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN julianday('now') - julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) >= 90 THEN 
                    ld.disbursed_amount * (julianday('now') - julianday(ld.current_maturity_on))
                ELSE 0 
            END
        ) AS overdue_principal_sum
    FROM institution i
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE ld.status != 'CLOSED'
      AND julianday('![](https://via.placeholder.com/15/FF0000/000000?text=+)now') - julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) >= 90
    GROUP BY i.institution_id
),
revenue_data AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        fs.annual_revenue
    FROM institution i
    JOIN party p ON p.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
    JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON p.party_id = fs.party_id
    WHERE fs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM financial_snapshot WHERE party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id)
)
SELECT 
    ns.institution_id,
    ns.npl_count,
    ns.overdue_principal_sum
FROM npl_stats ns
JOIN revenue_data rd ON ns.institution_id = rd.institution_id
WHERE ns.overdue_principal_sum > (rd.annual_revenue * 0.5)
ORDER BY ns.overdue_principal_sum DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_principal_balance,
    cs.risk_weighted_assets,
    ROUND((SUM(ld.dis!_amount) * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets) * 100, 2) AS loan_to_rwa_pct
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id AND ld.closed_on IS NULL
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    cs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot WHERE institution_id = i.institution_id)
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.risk_weighted_assets
ORDER BY 
    loan_to_rwa_pct DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    pi.payment_mode,
    COUNT(*) AS pending_instruction_count
FROM 
    payment_instruction pi
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE 
    pi.status = 'PENDING'
    AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    pi.payment_mode
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) > 45
ORDER BY 
    pending_instruction_count DESC,
    pi.payment_mode ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS abnormal_record_count,
    SUM(p.amount_value) AS abnormal_amount,
    cs.net_capital,
    fs.total_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(p.amount_value) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital * 100, 4) AS ratio_to_net_capital
FROM 
    prudential_metric_snapshot_v3 p
JOIN 
    institution i ON p.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON p.institution_id = cs.institution_id
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = ('PTY-' || p.institution_id)
WHERE 
    p.exception_flag = 1
    AND cs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot WHERE institution_id = p.institution_id)
    AND fs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM financial_snapshot WHERE party_id = 'PTY-' || p.institution_id)
GROUP BY 
    p.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital, fs.total_assets
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 8
ORDER BY 
    ratio_to!_to_net_capital DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.record_id) AS overdue_report_count,
    AVG(p.amount_value) AS avg_loan_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS under_provisioned_loan_count,
    ROUND(SUM(l.shortfall_amount), 2) AS provision_gap_amount
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    lending_control_event_v3 r ON i.institution_id = r.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON i.institution_id = (SELECT institution_id FROM credit_agreement WHERE agreement_id = ld.agreement_id)
JOIN 
    provision_snapshot p ON ld.loan_id = p.loan_id
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            ls.loan_id,
            ls.as_of_date,
            ls.required_amount - ls.recognized_amount AS shortfall_amount
        FROM 
            provision_snapshot ls
        WHERE 
            ls.required_amount > ls.recognized_amount
    ) l ON ld.loan_id = l.loan_id
WHERE 
    r.status_code = 'OVERDUE'
    AND r.completion_date IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.record_id) >= 25
ORDER BY 
    provision_gap_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cf.facility_id) AS total_credit_facilities,
    ROUND(SUM(gcr.amount_value), 2) AS governance_exception_amount,
    ROUND(AVG(gcr.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_observed_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
LEFT JOIN 
    credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
JOIN 
    governance_control_record_v3 gcr ON i.in!institution_id = gcr.institution_id
WHERE 
    gcr.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(gcr.record_id) >= 5
ORDER BY 
    governance_exception_amount DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS target_party_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS relation_type_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_non_related_party_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN 
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE 
    p.party_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT source_party_id 
        FROM party_relation 
        WHERE source_kind = '异常标记'
    )
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    target_party_count DESC,
    relation_type_count DESC,
    customer_name ASC;

WITH card_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        a.institution_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS valid_card_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS valid_customer_count
    FROM payment_card pc
    JOIN account a ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE pc.status = 'ACTIVE' AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY a.institution_id
),
risk_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ore.exception_flag = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_risk_count,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ore.exception_flag = 1 THEN ore.amount_value ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS abnormal_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ore.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abnormal_count
    FROM institution i
    LEFT JOIN operational_risk_event_v3 ore ON i.institution_id = ore.institution_id AND ore.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY i.institution_id
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ore.exception_flag = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 43
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COALESCE(cs.valid_card_count, 0) AS valid_card_count,
    COALESCE(cs.valid_customer_count, 0) AS valid_customer_count,
    COALESCE(rs.abnormal_amount, 0.00) AS abnormal_amount,
    COALESCE(rs.valid_risk_count, 0) AS valid_risk_count
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN card_stats cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
LEFT JOIN risk_stats rs ON i.institution_id = rs.institution_id
WHERE rs.valid_risk_count >= 43
ORDER BY rs.abnormal_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN wp.product_id END) AS active_product_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_actual_raise,
    COUNT(pce.record_id) AS conduct_record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pce.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(pce.record_id), 4) AS avg_exception_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    wealth_product wp ON i.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
JOIN 
    product_conduct_event_v3 pce ON i.institution_id = pce.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN pce.exception_flag =! 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    total_actual_raise DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ma.asset_id) AS total_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(ma.issued_amount), 2) AS total_issued_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ma.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN ma.asset_id END) AS valid_custody_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ma.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ma.exception_flag = 1 THEN ma.issued_amount ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS abnormal_amount
FROM 
    managed_asset ma
JOIN 
    institution i ON ma.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ma.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ma.exception_flag = 1 THEN ma.asset_id END) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    total_issued_amount DESC, 
    i.institution_name ASC;
